name: autovacuum_vacuum_cost_delay
description: Delay (in milliseconds) between vacuum cost units during autovacuum operations, used to throttle I/O and CPU impact.
symptoms: Uncontrolled bloat in heavily updated tables
Excessive CPU contention from concurrent autovacuum workers
tuning_tips: Decrease to speed up autovacuum on fast storage (e.g., NVMe); increase to reduce resource contention under high load. Prefer adjusting autovacuum_vacuum_cost_limit first for finer control.
